_note: The Moon's open-data map layers (docs/OPEN_DATA.md). The Moon's Library itself is built from code (hardware, crew audio, the nasa_views pack); this file adds whole-globe maps that the Library's Maps button shows in place of the LRO photo map. Files in media/ (built by scripts/open_data_build.py moon), credits in media/credits.json, sources in sources.json. backend/app/course_library.py checks it and serves it at GET /api/course/library.
title: Library

layers.title: Age
layers.say: Colours show how old the ground is. Purple and blue highlands are oldest. Gold lava plains and pale craters came later.

layers.title: Height
layers.say: Colours show height, from purple for low ground to red for high ground. The far side stands higher than the near side.
